candidates.evidence: Three Raman lines at 155, 299 and 353 cm-1 and nothing above 360. This is consistent with a layered metal oxychloride (MOCl). A strong, fully isotropic A1g-like line plus two twofold lines would fit an orthorhombic FeOCl-type layer. I assigned the material by family and not by matching a measured reference spectrum.
Same MOCl family, but the strong 144 cm-1 A1g and the ~200 and ~397 cm-1 Eg/B1g lines are missing. The 299 and 353 cm-1 lines are also not expected for BiOCl.
Same structure type, but the line positions do not match the expected Fe-O modes.
Same MOCl family, with no specific supporting line.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given, so the material was identified from the spectrum alone.

peaks.source: Angle-series fit. The parallel area is flat within ~±8% over 0-170 deg. The crossed area is consistent with zero (noise-level, <5% of parallel). The irrep label is inferred, not measured.

Parallel area varies about 20-fold with a 180-deg period (maximum near 30-50 deg, minimum near 90-170 deg). The crossed area is weak, noisy and also modulated (~0.5-6k counts), so its phase is poorly constrained. The irrep is not assigned.

Parallel area has a 180-deg period (minimum near 30 deg, maximum near 120-130 deg, ~7x contrast). It is roughly 90 deg out of phase with the 299 cm-1 line. The crossed area is weak (≤3k counts) and noisy. The irrep is not assigned.

limits: The material assignment (InOCl) rests on the MOCl-family pattern of three lines, not on a matched reference spectrum. No literature values were checked in this session. Treat it as a probable identification.
The twofold lines (299 and 353 cm-1) have a weak, noisy crossed channel, so the parallel/crossed phase relation and the exact irreps (Ag vs B1g/B2g/B3g) are not determined.
The 155 cm-1 line is flat in parallel and ~zero in crossed, which fits a totally symmetric mode. The data cannot distinguish whether the in-plane Raman tensor is exactly isotropic or only nearly so.
There is no substrate line, as expected for a suspended sample. Layer number, strain and doping cannot be determined from these data.
The BiOCl, FeOCl and SbOCl alternatives are not excluded quantitatively. They are ranked lower because their expected characteristic lines are absent or do not match.
Weak features near 75, 135, 567 cm-1 and others are at or below the noise level and are not reported as peaks.
